display_policy: Blank inputs: fraction of schema-valid empty reports. Other cells: event F1 only with positive required scoped support; otherwise recovery N/A, regardless of output, with scoped FP and schema-invalid counts visible.
saved_score_policy: The f1 arrays and cell aggregate_event_metrics retain unchanged frozen-metric aggregation, including zero-support F1=0. Only display_values are masked. Original per-episode values remain in each cell.
scope_caveat: No required scoped events does not establish silence or physical absence. Excluded modulation is unobserved. Authoritative truth events/booleans and actual final_state.sample_rate_hz override inherited scope prose and base-generator sample_rate_hz.

real_excerpt_mixtures.meaning: AI-reference agreement for mixtures of real excerpts, not source-separation accuracy. Sparse cells have different parents; no factorial interaction inference.

caption: Top: exact scoped synthetic outcomes. Blank inputs show the fraction of schema-valid empty reports. Nonblank cells without required scoped events show recovery N/A with scoped FP and schema-invalid episode counts (S); they do not establish silence or physical absence. Frozen F1/counts remain in the input artifact; excluded modulation is unobserved. Actual waveform state and truth events/booleans take precedence over inherited scope prose/base sample-rate metadata. Bottom: sparse real-excerpt mixtures, scored only against admitted AI references. Unsampled/unavailable-reference cells are explicit. Different cells can have different parents; this is not a replicated factorial interaction analysis.
